Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-11-17 · App: NativeCode (com.zenithblue.nativecode) · Developer: ZenithBlue

NativeCode is a developer environment that runs an Alpaquita Linux PRoot guest, an optional X11 desktop, terminal sessions, agent chat and optional third-party AI CLIs. This policy describes how information is handled when you use the Android app.

01

Summary

  • ▸NativeCode is local-first. We show no ads and run no NativeCode cloud or account backend.
  • ▸Your files, projects, packages and credentials stay on this device — inside the Alpaquita Linux PRoot guest and app-private storage.
  • ▸Optional, off by default: crash reports (Firebase Crashlytics) and anonymous usage statistics (Google Analytics for Firebase). Nothing is sent until you opt in during onboarding or in Settings → Crash reports & usage stats, and you can turn either off at any time.
  • ▸Optional features (GitHub login, AI CLI auth, package installs) contact third parties you choose.
  • ▸Auth tokens and credentials, when used, are stored on-device only.

02

Information on your device

  • ▸App preferences — UI, terminal, onboarding and PRoot settings.
  • ▸Linux guest data — Alpaquita rootfs, packages, home-directory files and projects you create.
  • ▸Auth material (optional) — GitHub CLI tokens, AI CLI API keys or device-login sessions under guest home.
  • ▸Session state — terminal history, chat history, project paths, onboarding progress.
  • ▸This data is under your control. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes app-owned data.

03

Information sent over the network

  • ▸Guest packages and tools — apk repositories, npm registry and official tool hosts, only when you install. The rootfs is delivered by Google Play.
  • ▸GitHub authentication and API — github.com, only when you connect GitHub.
  • ▸AI CLI install, auth and use — official vendor endpoints for the tools you enable. AI providers may receive prompts, selected code or files, account identifiers, diagnostics and generated output when you use their tools.
  • ▸We do not sell personal information. Third parties process data under their own privacy policies.

04

Crash reports & usage statistics (optional)

  • ▸Both are off until you opt in. Switches: Settings → Crash reports & usage stats.
  • ▸Crash reports (Firebase Crashlytics): stack traces and error messages of app crashes, device model, OS version, app version, a Crashlytics installation ID, and a few settings keys (Linux backend, GPU mode, last update result). An error message can include a file path inside app storage.
  • ▸Usage statistics (Google Analytics for Firebase): a fixed list of in-app events (e.g. setup complete, AI session start, paywall view, Pro purchase, desktop start, component update) with short identifiers only, plus an app-instance ID.
  • ▸Never sent: file contents, prompts, terminal input or output, account names, tokens or keys. The advertising ID is not collected.
  • ▸Data is processed by Google under the Firebase terms. It is not sold and not used for advertising.

05

Permissions

  • ▸NativeCode may request Android permissions for its features — e.g. notifications for foreground services that keep terminal, agent chat, desktop and SSH sessions alive, and network access. Permissions are used only for the stated in-app purpose.

06

Sharing

  • ▸We do not sell or rent your data. Data leaves the device only when you authenticate to a third party, install remote packages you chose, a tool you run makes its own network calls, or you opted in to crash reports or usage statistics.

07

Retention

  • ▸Local app and guest data is kept until you delete it, clear storage, or uninstall.
  • ▸Tokens and keys are kept until you sign out, overwrite config, clear guest home, clear app data, or uninstall.
  • ▸Crash reports are kept up to 90 days. Usage statistics are kept up to 2 months. Both are then deleted automatically.

08

Data deletion

  • ▸NativeCode by ZenithBlue — how to delete your data.
  • ▸Data on your device: delete projects and files in the app; Settings → GitHub Account → LOGOUT; Settings → AI CLI tools → per-tool LOGOUT or CLEAR ALL AI CREDENTIALS; or Android App info → Clear storage, or uninstall.
  • ▸Crash reports & usage statistics: 1) turn both off in Settings → Crash reports & usage stats — collection stops at once; 2) to delete data already sent, email zenithblue.dev@gmail.com with the subject "NativeCode data deletion". We delete it within 30 days.
  • ▸Deleted: crash reports and usage statistics linked to your installation. Kept: nothing beyond the automatic expiry above (crash reports 90 days, usage statistics 2 months).
  • ▸Data held by GitHub or AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI and others) is deleted in those services' own account settings.

09

Security

  • ▸Traffic to third parties uses HTTPS where supported. Credentials live in app and guest storage — protect your device with a lock screen.
  • ▸Android backup is disabled for NativeCode. Protect any separate device backups you create.

10

Children's privacy

  • ▸NativeCode is a developer tool intended for adults and professional use. It is not directed at children under 13 (or the age required by local law).

11

AI-generated content

  • ▸Optional AI CLIs run as third-party tools inside the guest environment. You are responsible for how you use them and for complying with each vendor's terms.
  • ▸In-app: Settings → AI Safety & Report — vendor terms links, report forms and a developer report path (zenithblue.dev@gmail.com).

12

Changes & contact

  • ▸We may update this policy; the Last updated date will change.
  • ▸Developer: ZenithBlue. Questions: zenithblue.dev@gmail.com.
